messages:
Samira (People Ops): Follow-up from the all-hands Q&A. Opening this thread for any remaining questions about performance review timing, appeal steps, comp transparency, and development plans. We'll answer here and drop templates.
Evan (Engineering Manager): Thanks. Quick note: two L3s asked whether peer feedback will be visible to candidates during calibration.
Maya (People Ops): Peer feedback is summarized for calibration but not shared verbatim with candidates. Managers should synthesize themes for feedback conversations.
Priya: If someone disagrees with their review outcome, whats the formal appeal flow?
Samira (People Ops): Appeal flow: 1) Employee discusses with manager within 14 days, 2) if unresolved, file an appeal form within 21 days, 3) People Ops reviews + convenes an independent adjudication panel. Panel decision is final. Will post appeal form link shortly.
Carlos: Is the appeal anonymized? worried about manager retaliation.
Maya (People Ops): Appeals are treated as confidential. Panel members do not include direct managers from the same org. We also monitor for retaliation and have a separate reporting channel.
Nora: Will there be granular band salary ranges published? engineering wants band midpoints.
Samira (People Ops): We will publish band ranges (min/market mid/max) for IC tracks next week. Theyll be visibility-level 'banded' not individual salaries. Expect a spreadsheet and a short explainer doc.
Evan (Engineering Manager): Any guidance on managers giving salary expectations during interviews? we get asked by candidates.
Maya (People Ops): Managers should share band ranges and note that offers depend on experience and market signals. Use the candidate-handbook snippet: "Role-level band: $X - $Y; final offer considers experience, comp history, and equity bucket."
Priya: For promotions that include equity refreshers, is there a standard refresh size or is it ad-hoc?
Samira (People Ops): Typical equity refresh for a promotion is 10-25% of current grant for mid-career moves; senior promotions get larger grants. It's discretionary and tied to role level + budget.
Carlos: Can promotions be backdated if someones work clearly crossed the bar before the window?
Maya (People Ops): Retroactive promotions are rare but possible for documented cases (e.g., missed review due to leave). They require comp approval and payroll coordination; expect effective date to be the start of the next payroll cycle.
Nora: Will we get a manager checklist for documenting impact?
Maya (People Ops): Yes  manager checklist + artifact examples will be uploaded. Quick bulleted checklist: 1) concise impact statement, 2) 3 representative deliverables, 3) measurable outcomes, 4) stakeholder testimonials.
Evan (Engineering Manager): One request: can People Ops provide anonymized distribution of promotions by org so leaders can check fairness signals?
Samira (People Ops): We can provide org-level aggregates (counts by level/gender/region where available) after calibration. No individual names.
Priya: What about comp corrections for market misalignment identified after an offer was accepted?
Maya (People Ops): If market data shows a clear misalignment within 90 days, managers can request a market adjustment. We'll need comp data and rationale.
Carlos: Is there a fast-track for high-impact ICs on rare skills (infra, LLM infra) to get bandwidth for promotions?
Samira (People Ops): We maintain an exceptions queue for critical roles. Manager must submit business case + impact metrics; VP sign-off required.
Nora: Can we see a sample appeal form? would help people know what evidence to collect.
Maya (People Ops): Sample appeal payload below (copy/paste):
```
Appeal form template:
- Employee name:
- Role/level at time of review:
- Manager:
- Date of review notification:
- Reason for appeal (short):
- Evidence (links to PRs, dashboards, customer emails):
- Desired outcome:
- Optional: list of reviewers to exclude (with justification):
```
Evan (Engineering Manager): One logistics Q: when the band ranges are published, will they include regional cost-of-living adjustments?
Samira (People Ops): Band tables will be normalized to USD midpoints and will include a regional multiplier map. Local payroll will compute final offers in local currency.
Priya: Any update on managers' training for unbiased calibration? last time it was helpful but short.
Samira (People Ops): We're running a 60-min calibration + inclusivity refresher on Oct 1 and Oct 5. Mandatory for calibration panel members. Recordings will be available.
Carlos: Bonus timing follow-up: if someone changes teams mid-year, which team gets credit for their bonus?
Maya (People Ops): Bonuses are prorated by time in each org. Managers coordinate to allocate impact; People Ops does the final payout calculation.
Nora: Thanks  will folks be notified when the band doc and appeal form are live?
HR Bot: Heads up: Level bands doc and appeal form will be published to https://redwood.internal/people-resources on 2026-10-01 16:00 UTC.
Samira (People Ops): Great thread  we'll pin these artifacts here when available. If you need help prepping evidence for your report-outs, ping @PeopleOps or drop a DM.
